import sys
import re

def main():
    counters = [0] * 6
    slug_counter = {}
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.rstrip("\n")
        if not line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        level = len(line) - len(line.lstrip("#"))
        if level < 1 or level > 6:
            continue
        text = line[level:].strip()
        text = re.sub(r'^\s*#+\s*', '', text)
        text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\- ]', '', text)
        text = text.lower().replace(" ", "-")
        counters[level - 1] += 1
        for i in range(level, 6):
            counters[i] = 0
        number = ".".join(str(c) for c in counters[:level])
        slug = text
        slug_key = slug
        slug_num = slug_counter.get(slug_key, slug_key)
        while slug_num in slug_counter:
            slug_num = f"{slug_key}-{slug_counter[slug_key]}"
        slug_counter[slug_key] = slug_num
        print("  " * (level - 1) + f"{number} {text} (#{slug_num})")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
